style: Cartoon art for a children's animated TV show, like a cosy 1990s Nintendo game. Very simple rounded flat shapes, bold clean flat colours with only one soft shade per shape, no outlines, no brushstrokes, no fine detail. Soft pastel rainbow colours: lilac, pink, mint green, sky blue and sunny yellow. Sweet, friendly and magical.
negative: realistic, photorealistic, painterly, brushstrokes, oil painting, detailed texture, fur texture, 3d render, glossy, shiny, realistic lighting, dramatic shadows, thick outlines, scary, extra limbs, extra legs, extra horns, people, humans, text, letters, words, signature, watermark

character.prompt: Full-body cartoon character, our own original character, isolated on a plain flat white background, no scenery, standing on the bottom edge, facing right in three-quarter view, centred, nothing else in the picture

background.prompt: Wide cartoon background, no characters, no animals, interesting detail in the top half, a wide plain open area of grass or ground across the bottom third, soft gradient sky

sticker.prompt: Round sticker, a single simple object centred on a pale circular sticker with a thick white border, plain white background outside the sticker

unicorn-happy.prompt: A cute young unicorn foal with a big rounded head, a short soft body and short legs. Pale lilac-white coat, a flowing rainbow mane and rainbow tail, a small golden spiral horn, little lilac hooves, small dark dot eyes and rosy cheeks. Very happy, big smile, prancing with one front leg lifted.

Pale lilac-white coat, a flowing rainbow mane and rainbow tail, a small golden spiral horn, little lilac hooves, small dark dot eyes and rosy cheeks. Thinking, head tilted, looking up, small puzzled mouth, standing on all four hooves.
